question: Can the existing journey explicitly end its outer trial while preserving actual costs, confirmed identity, historical child facts and cargo loss without manufacturing defeat, return or completion?
baseline: The existing journey has no explicit outer termination. Closing its ephemeral process loses inspectable history; the child Session has no retreat API.
intervention: An original irreversible outer withdrawal after actual first Begin and before final completion. This closes this bounded trial only; it is not physical retreat, world return or a child defeat.
hypothesis: One accepted withdrawal retains every child gameplay fact and paid resource while marking the still-active or survey-won child observation historical and preventing further mutating delegation.
rivals: A fabricated child defeat or Complete could explain disabled controls: compare entire child state exactly before/after withdrawal.
Refunded resources could explain apparent safety: compare acquired/spent fittings, real inventory, rig consumption, XP, health and resolve exactly.
A hidden live path could remain after rendering termination: actually send later actions, Begin, preparation and assembly and require refusal without child changes.
A renderer could falsely show completion/refund despite correct server facts: serve an isolated actual renderer mutation and require the same fidelity assertion to reject it.
Offline time/read requests could resolve the frozen encounter: repeat actual GET and inspect unchanged revision/gameplay facts.
acceptance: Actual confirmed active journey with acquired carried sample withdraws; carried custody becomes lost with withdrawal reason while its acquisition receipt remains historical.
Actual survey-won but final-incomplete journey can withdraw without advancing stage, granting final XP or spending remaining rigs.
Pre-entry and post-final-completion withdrawal refuse without mutation; stale, malformed and forged withdrawal cannot manufacture a paid transition.

Actual browser shows outer termination and historical encounter, keeps the same confirmed identity, hides/disables all child mutation controls and never labels withdrawal as actual final completion or observed return.
Actual controlled renderer defect is rejected for a specific visible false assertion, not subprocess/browser/environment failure.
Producer and actual source dependency identities stay stable throughout final execution.
scientific_basis: SCI-013 full chapter: rival explanations and distinct predictions
SCI-017 full chapter: actual intervention, positive/negative controls and software trials distinct from people
limits: Software ownership/UI fidelity only. No human agency, enjoyment, balance, accessibility, world travel, Unity, Windows or Steam validation. Multiple controls and trials overlap and are not independent participants.
